summary: Sync Reserving Class with ResQ and Export Reserving Class to ResQ now hand their request to the Bridge through the ArcRho Gateway instead of writing it across the network share.
details: The request is published on the server and its progress is read there, so a Client PC no longer writes or polls the Bridge queue over the mapped drive.
A wait that hears nothing from the Bridge for thirty seconds is abandoned with a clear message rather than left polling.
A macro run from a script outside the app still uses the shared folder directly.
